description: Start a Deep AI Dive run: asks every enabled AI answer engine (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overview, Claude) every saved question for the brand's SAVED topics and scores brand mentions/citations vs. competitors. COSTS REAL MONEY: each run makes paid engine/Apify calls and charges credits, so only call it when the user clearly wants a fresh run. Capped at ONE manual run per calendar month per brand, one run at a time, and requires PRO or Enterprise. Runs the brand's existing saved config only (ai_visibility_topics_list shows what that includes: topics with selected=true); it needs the Deep AI Dive to have been set up once in the dashboard. A topic added with ai_visibility_topic_add is NOT part of the run until ai_visibility_topic_include has finished drafting its questions; the response warns if any custom topic is left out. Returns immediately with { started: true, runsStarted }; the run takes a few minutes — poll ai_visibility_run_status, then read results with search_ai_visibility. Refusals come back as { started: false, refusal, message } (not an error): refusal is one of tier_upgrade_required, running, no_config, monthly_limit.
name: ai_visibility_run
